scenario_name: Sichuan Wenchuan earthquake rescue route planning with AMap data
description: Road geometry comes from AMap Web Service. Earthquake collapse risk is generated by overlaying a representative Wenchuan earthquake impact buffer with road polylines.
historical_event_name: 2008 Wenchuan earthquake Yingxiu-Wenchuan road impact zone
risk_design_note: For this mountainous earthquake scenario, collapse risk is treated as near-interruption risk rather than ordinary congestion, so the collapse factor is set higher than urban scenarios.
